_comment: Brand-domain registry. Keys are canonical OpenAPI tag strings (must match Endpoints.php tag exactly); values are admin-UI metadata (human label, slug for tab data attribute / URL hash, accent colour). Brand-positioning rule, canonical domain order: Western Astrology, Vedic Astrology, Forecast, Human Design, Chinese Astrology, Feng Shui, Numerology, Tarot, Biorhythm, I Ching, Crystals, Dreams, Angel Numbers. Languages, Location, and Usage at the end. Accent must be one of the eight the admin CSS defines (amber, blue, green, indigo, neutral, orange, pink, purple); anything else renders unstyled. Any OpenAPI tag with no entry here falls through to the catch-all Other tab, so every tag in Endpoints.php needs a row. New OpenAPI tag = new entry here, then npm run generate; no PHP edits required.
